designs.name: 余烬·裂岳
designs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one premium fantasy RPG weapon concept illustration, a full-length TWO-HANDED BATTLEAXE, isolated on nearly black charcoal background, tall portrait image. Entire axe visible with generous margins, head at top, pommel at bottom, near frontal three-quarter view showing geometric thickness. Original Heteromorphic series for a Skyrim mod: entirely bold solid geometric energy shapes, thick planar faces and crisp emissive edges, elegant purposeful negative space, visually weighty head, long practical straight two-handed grip with clear unobstructed hand area in lower half. Clean glowing colored energy rather than metal or crystal: no metallic shine, scratches, realistic stone, leather, gems, engraving or runes. Controlled restrained bloom, preserve saturated colored body and readable silhouette, no blown-out white glow. Sparse tiny matching geometric particles near head only. No person, hands, scenery, text, captions, logo, watermark, panels or extra weapons. Weapon should be feasible as a small collection of connected extruded polygonal forms, not dozens of floating pieces. Palette: crimson and red-coral edges. Design: dominant single broad angular bearded axe blade on LEFT, shaped as a brutally clean trapezoid with a long descending cutting edge, two stepped triangular notches at the heel and a large triangular window near the neck. A short heavy wedge counterweight on RIGHT rather than a second blade. Strong offset asymmetric silhouette. One thick angular brace runs from the shaft up under the blade, small pointed geometric pommel. 3-5 small red triangular embers drifting near edge.
